'''Capari-series laminate beast armor''' was a model of armor designed by [[Piccatech Ltd.]] to protect animals. The armor was sold for 2,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and was made of the same [[Polycarbonate/Legends|polycarbonte]] [[Destri-series laminate beast armor]], yet was both lighter and cheaper.<ref name="Stay on Target" />
